home.heroLine: Search and selection across Southern Africa for mining, construction, finance, engineering, and manufacturing.
home.aboutHeading: Matched to the work, not just the job title.
home.aboutBody: Finding the right candidate takes more than matching a CV to a job description. We take the time to understand the role, the business and the people behind it, connecting employers with professionals who bring the right experience, skills and fit.
home.industriesIntro: Every industry has its own demands. We match roles to the skills and experience each site, plant, or team actually needs—and hire for other professional roles when the brief sits outside these industries.
home.placementsBody: Employers get people who fit the role and the site. Candidates get opportunities matched to their experience and where they want to go next—across mining, construction, finance, engineering, manufacturing, and other professional fields.
